decided: The setting that lets the AI run the next command itself grants a command only when the setting marks that command true; a command left out, or marked anything else, is not granted, so a project that adds no setting works exactly as today.
alternatives: a list of the places where the AI must stop, so any place left out is granted
a list of moves from one command to the next
why: Leaving a command out should never give the AI a permission; each permission is written down on its own, as the program's rulings require.
